summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature without running tests or repository code. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the formatter entry (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and the Control.title classmethod with a docstring; rich/console.py adds set_window_title beside show_cursor, returning False without buffering when not a terminal; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one elif branch calling term.set_title(title); CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 2200 above Fixed. Tests added: test_control_title in tests/test_control.py, test_set_window_title in tests/test_console.py (skips when console.legacy_windows is set, since WINDOWS is not imported there), and test_control_set_window_title in tests/test_windows_renderer.py (Windows-only). Not committed. Tests were not run, so pass/fail status is unknown; Black formatting was checked by reading only.
